blockingIssues.description: The validation feature weakens `tests/unit/renumbering/test_species_contract.py` to accept legacy `rhesus_H` HMM names for macaque/rhesus instead of preserving the documented local-HMM routing contract. Existing shared knowledge in `.factory/library/renumbering-hmm-selection.md` and the prior renumbering scrutiny review already identify legacy-HMM priority as a regression, so this masks a known problem rather than validating it.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` to document the current Airr macaque recovery path: provider-filtered references that resolve with no V genes now expand to all supported sources before falling back to direct germlines, and V genes missing IMGT positions are skipped instead of aborting the whole BLAST-db build.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Relax the strict RED-first wording for investigation-heavy Airr bugs and remove the stale `sadie-airr` skill reference. The skill should explicitly allow root-cause analysis before new test writing when the failing surface is not yet understood.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The reviewed macaque fix handoff notes that investigation of the reference-build/data-flow failure had to happen before writing targeted regression tests, and the current skill text still points workers to a non-existent `sadie-airr` skill.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: For validation-only or regression-check features, require workers to consult existing scrutiny reviews and `.factory/library/` notes before changing assertions or fixtures to match current behavior.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The failed `cross-area-regression-check` review found that `tests/unit/renumbering/test_species_contract.py` was loosened to accept `rhesus_H` even though `.factory/library/renumbering-hmm-selection.md` and the prior renumbering scrutiny review already documented that legacy-HMM routing as a regression.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require long-running background validators to record their eventual completion status and key summary line in the final handoff, including the log path when the command is detached.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The failed `cross-area-regression-check` review found that the strongest full-suite evidence (`817 passed` from the detached pytest log) never appeared in the worker handoff, leaving the recorded validation evidence weaker than what actually ran.
